prompt_additions.task_line:
Task: LISTENING comprehension, one multiple-select question.
The human heard the passage once, as audio, and cannot replay it. You are shown the transcript of what they heard.
Answer ONLY the question marked 'Question to predict'. The other questions are shown so you know how this particular person answered them -- do not answer them again.
prompt_additions.reasoning_preamble:
First think about what this particular human would still be holding on to from the passage, inside a single block:
<reasoning>
... your reasoning about what they would remember, what would blur, and which options that makes tempting ...
</reasoning>
Keep the reasoning to at most four sentences. Do not work through the options one by one, and do not second-guess yourself -- state what this human would retain and what would slip, then stop.
Then, on the line after </reasoning>:
prompt_additions.format_rules_answer:
Output ONLY a line in this exact format:
Answer: 1,3
(List every option number this human would select, separated by commas. If they would select none of the content options, use the "None of the above" option number.)
prompt_additions.sibling_header: The same human answered these other questions about the same passage (ok = exactly right, -n = missed n true options, +n = took n false ones):
prompt_additions.unit_of_prediction: one (participant, topic, question); the listening task's own prompt asks for all five questions of a passage at once
